about: Film-only LAUNCH STATE configuration and demo data for the NavisLabs launch film (V6). Every entity, record and connector status the film shows comes from this file; components read it through src/ui/demoContent.ts. It does not describe or change the product code: the launch film represents the planned launch-state connector set supplied by the founder/team. Public website status may lag this film configuration. All customer, account, issue and repository records are fictional FILM DEMO data.
names_policy: Only names already approved in the film dataset are used: Abhishek Meena (founder, REAL_AUTHORIZED) and NavisLabs; everyone and everything else is SYNTHETIC. Mulayam Kumar and Digantara are not used: the dataset has no written authorization for either (Digantara is a real company). Swapping them in is a one-field change here once approved.
